lines.en: label mollycafe10:
scene mollycafe19
: And that’s when I was like, “Watch your mouth, lich! You’re messin’ with the wrong priest!”
lines.zh: : 就在那时我就说了句「说话注意点，巫妖！你惹错牧师了！」

lines.en: : And right before my holy nova went off, a swarm of adds spawned and aggro’ed straight to me so fast that the tank rage-quit on just our third wipe.
lines.zh: : 就在我的神圣新星炸开之前，突然刷出一群小怪，仇恨瞬间全冲着我来，快得我们的坦克才第三次团灭就直接骂娘退队了。

lines.en: : Some people just aren’t meant for progression raiding, you know?
lines.zh: : 有些人就是不适合打进度团本，您说是不是？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: As you can see, I’m caught up in yet another “conversation” with Molly and beginning to question whether or not I will ever be able to talk about things {i}I{/i} like with her.
lines.zh: 如你所见，我又一次陷进了和 Molly 的「对话」里，开始怀疑自己这辈子到底能不能跟她聊点{i}我{/i}喜欢的东西。

lines.en: Mind you, the list of things I like is limited to...cute girls, sex, food, and sleep...And maybe those aren’t really the best conversation pieces after all.
lines.zh: 话说回来，我喜欢的东西也就限于……可爱的女孩、性爱、食物和睡觉……而这些大概本来就不算什么好的谈资。

lines.en: : Oh well. That’s fine. You don’t really need to get it. I can fill you in on all of the stuff you don’t understand so that when you finally start your free trial, you’ll know the basics.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，没关系。您其实不用懂。我可以把您不明白的东西全都给您补上，这样等您终于开了免费试玩，至少基础都懂了。

lines.en: : The basics of what? I don’t have time for video games.
lines.zh: : 什么的基础？我可没时间打游戏。

lines.en: scene mollycafe6
: Why do you have so much time to hang out with [teenage]girls but no time to play games?! That doesn’t make any sense!
lines.zh: : 您明明有那么多时间跟[teenage]女孩混在一起，为什么就没时间打游戏？！这完全说不通啊！

lines.en: : I don’t have time to play games because I {i}have{/i} to hang out with [teenage]girls. It is my calling.
lines.zh: : 我没时间打游戏，是因为我{i}得{/i}跟[teenage]女孩们混在一起。这是我的天职。

lines.en: : Just like how your calling is guarding emeralds or whatever it is you do.
lines.zh: : 就像你的天职是守护翡翠还是什么的，随你怎么说。

lines.en: scene mollycafe14
: I don’t guard emeralds! I’m the Emerald Guardian! It is very different!
lines.zh: : 我不是守护翡翠！我是翡翠守护者！这完全不一样！

lines.en: : So like, you’re...made of emeralds? I’m not really sure what you’re trying to get at here.
lines.zh: : 所以也就是说，你是……翡翠做的？我不太明白你到底想表达什么。

lines.en: : Jeez. Give the girl a break, man. She’s just trying to get you interested in her hobbies.
lines.zh: : 天哪。老兄，你就饶了她吧。她只是想让你对她的爱好产生兴趣而已。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe1
I turn around to find both Rin and Futaba waiting behind me in line.
lines.zh: 我转过身，发现 Rin 和 Futaba 正排在我身后等着。

lines.en: I didn’t even hear the two of them come in.
lines.zh: 我甚至没听见她们俩是什么时候进来的。

lines.en: Probably on account of Molly’s obnoxiously loud voice, but still.
lines.zh: 大概是因为 Molly 那吵死人的大嗓门，不过即便如此。

lines.en: If I were her, I’d probably make some comment about their skill in stealth or something along those lines, but I’m-
lines.zh: 如果我是她，大概会拿她们的潜行技巧什么的调侃两句，但我——

lines.en: Wait...why did that thought even occur to me? Have I really been spending so much time with Molly that this is just...the way I think now?
lines.zh: 等等……我怎么会冒出这种念头？难道我真的跟 Molly 待了太久，以至于现在连思考方式都变成这样了？

lines.en: What is happening to me?
lines.zh: 我到底是怎么了？

lines.en: : How long have you two been standing there?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在那儿站多久了？

lines.en: : Since the part with the lich. So not that long at all.
lines.zh: : 从巫妖那段开始。所以其实没多久。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s only been a few-
lines.zh: : 对，也就才几——

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe2
: Hey, wait a minute! What are you doing here so late?!
lines.zh: : 等等！你怎么这么晚在这儿？！

lines.en: : You’re supposed to be {i}my{/i} guinea pig! Not Molly's!
lines.zh: : 你应该是{i}我的{/i}小白鼠才对！不是 Molly 的！

lines.en: : Am I not good enough for you anymore?! Explain yourself, damn it!
lines.zh: : 难道我已经不够好了吗？！你给我解释清楚，可恶！

lines.en: : Uh...umm...
: It’s really not what it looks like. I-
lines.zh: : 真的不是你看到的那样。我——

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe3
: Futaba, I’m being cheated on. Hold me.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我被劈腿了。抱抱我。

lines.en: : I’m...a little confused. But I don’t have a problem-
lines.zh: : 我……有点懵。不过我没意见——

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe4
: Oh, such sorrow. Having your favorite customer stolen by a girl with minimal talent who put all of her points into charisma.
lines.zh: : 哦，何等悲哀。自己最喜欢的客人，被一个把点数全点在魅力上、几乎没什么本事的女孩抢走了。

lines.en: : Why are you touching me? I asked for Futaba.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛抱着我？我要的是 Futaba。

lines.en: : Because even if we are arch nemeses...I still love you.
lines.zh: : 因为就算我们是死对头……我还是爱着你啊。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe5
: They’re always like this. Don’t pay it any mind.
lines.zh: : 她们俩一直都这样。别放在心上。

lines.en: : Half of our club meetings are just the two of them arguing about things. I’m sure they’ll be back to normal in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 我们社团活动有一半时间都是她们俩在吵来吵去。我保证她们很快就会恢复正常的。

lines.en: : You’re in the manga club too, Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba 你也在漫画社？

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe6
: She’s not just in the club, she’s the vice president of it!
lines.zh: : 她可不只是社员，她是副社长呢！

lines.en: : Wait, really? Who’s the president then?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？那社长是谁？

lines.en: : Yours truly!
lines.zh: : 正是在下！

lines.en: : Weren’t you just telling me the other day that it was hard for you to even be accepted into the club?
lines.zh: : 你前两天不是还跟我说，光是被社团接纳就很不容易吗？

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe7
: Wait, did you really say something like that? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真说过那种话？为什么？

lines.en: : We wouldn’t have made you the new president if we didn’t accept you.
lines.zh: : 我们要是不接纳你，就不会让你当新社长了。

lines.en: : Well...I...uhh...
scene mollysecondcafe8
: Anyway! That's not what we're talking about right now!
lines.zh: : 总之！我们现在聊的不是这个！

lines.en: : Sir, do you now understand just how powerful I truly am?! You should be thankful to have such a strong force on your side! Willing to fight tooth and nail for your honor!
lines.zh: : 先生，您现在明白我到底有多强了吗？！有这么强大的战力站在您这边，您该感恩戴德才对！为了您的名誉，我愿意赴汤蹈火！

lines.en: : I can assure you that any honor I may have had was lost long, long ago.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，我那点名誉（如果真有过的话）早就丢得一干二净了。

lines.en: : Then we must begin the side quest to track it down at once!
lines.zh: : 那我们必须立刻开启找回它的支线任务！

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe9
: Uhh, can I order a drink or do I need to get back there and make it myself?
lines.zh: : 呃，我还能点杯饮料吗，还是说我得自己进去做？

lines.en: : What would you like to order, miss?
lines.zh: : 您想点什么，小姐？

lines.en: : Quad grande upside down caramel macchiato. Extra caramel.
lines.zh: : 四份浓缩、大杯、反转焦糖玛奇朵。多加焦糖。

lines.en: : Black coffee?
lines.zh: : 黑咖啡？

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe10
: Ugh. I’ll just do it.
lines.zh: : 唉。我自己来吧。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe11
Rin breaks free from Molly’s grasp and gets behind the counter to make whatever the hell she just said she wanted.
lines.zh: Rin 挣脱 Molly 的钳制，绕到柜台后面去做她刚才说的那个不知是什么鬼的东西。

lines.en: : As you can see, Sir, I’m pretty horrible at my job.
lines.zh: : 您也看到了，先生，我干这行干得相当糟糕。

lines.en: : At least you’re aware of it.
lines.zh: : 至少你有自知之明。

lines.en: : I’m not great at mine either, but it still seems to be working out somehow.
lines.zh: : 我自己的工作干得也不怎么样，但不知怎么的也还过得去。

lines.en: : Aye. Because the two of us are cut from the same cloth! Two peas in a pod! Mercenaries selling ourselves to the highest bidder!
lines.zh: : 正是。因为我们俩是一路货色！一个模子刻出来的！都是把自己卖给出价最高的人的佣兵！

lines.en: : I’m glad to see the two of you are getting along so well despite only having just met each other recently.
lines.zh: : 看到你们俩明明才刚认识不久，却相处得这么好，我很高兴。

lines.en: : Is that what this is called? Getting along? Because Molly more or less just yells stuff at me every time the two of us are together.
lines.zh: : 这叫相处得好？每次我们俩凑一块儿，Molly 基本上都只是冲着我嚷嚷。

lines.en: : I yell things at everyone. It is an endearing character trait.
lines.zh: : 我对谁都嚷嚷。这可是我讨人喜欢的性格特质。

lines.en: : You should try to be more like Futaba and never yell anything at anyone.
lines.zh: : 你该学学 Futaba，从来不对任何人嚷嚷。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe12
: Ah! Oh no! It’s my worst nightmare come to life!
lines.zh: : 啊！不好了！我最可怕的噩梦成真了！

lines.en: : You’re into the dandere type, aren’t you, Sir?!
lines.zh: : 您喜欢的是 dandere 那一型，对吧，先生？！

lines.en: : The what?...
lines.zh: : 什么型？……

lines.en: : Weebnote: Dandere characters are the super quiet, awkward ones with surprisingly cute sides that they break out just to get into your head!
lines.zh: : 宅知识小抄：dandere 指的是特别安静、怯生生的那一类角色，却会突然露出意外可爱的一面，专门用来钻进你的脑子里！

lines.en: : It's all a ploy! None of it is real!
lines.zh: : 全都是套路！没有一样是真的！

lines.en: : Fight the moe, Sir! Fight it!
lines.zh: : 抵抗萌力量，先生！抵抗它！

lines.en: : All that stuff about them being freaks in the sack is purely fiction! Don't give in!
lines.zh: : 说什么她们在床上很疯狂，那纯粹是虚构的！别上当！

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe12
: Ah! Shit! I dropped my freakin'-
lines.zh: : 啊！操！我把我那该死的——

lines.en: : Molly, what the Hell are you talking about over there?! You know my hands stop working correctly when that sort of stuff comes up!
lines.zh: : Molly，你那边到底在说什么鬼东西？！你知道一提到那种事我的手就不听使唤了！

lines.en: : I am sorry, but this is a major crisis! Sensei is about to leave us for Futaba!
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉，但这是重大危机！Sensei 就要为了 Futaba 抛弃我们了！

lines.en: : That archetype sounds more like Sana than Futaba, to tell the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那种原型听起来更像 Sana 而不是 Futaba。

lines.en: : Futaba can be a little quiet at times but she’s not ever really {i}awkward.{/i}
lines.zh: : Futaba 有时候是挺安静的，但她其实从不{i}怯场{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe13
: I’m...only quiet in school, really...
lines.zh: : 我……其实只是在学校里安静啦……

lines.en: : That’s true, I guess. You’re actually quite talkative whenever we're in the library.
lines.zh: : 好像也是。我们在图书馆的时候，你其实挺能聊的。

lines.en: : Which is kind of...the opposite of how you’re supposed to be in the library, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，这跟你在图书馆里「应有」的表现……好像正好相反。

lines.en: : Oh! I’m glad the Supreme Overlord brought the library up cause I’ve been meaning to ask you if they have any of the resources I need for our one-shot thingy.
lines.zh: : 哦！很高兴至高霸主提到了图书馆，因为我一直想问你，那里有没有我们那个「一次性团」需要的资料。

lines.en: : One-shot thingy? What does that mean?
lines.zh: : 一次性团？那是什么意思？

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe14
: Oh ho ho~ You want in, Sir? Why didn’t you just say so?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵～您想加入吗，先生？您早说不就好了？

lines.en: : Probably because I still have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我到现在还不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : She’s talking about...Dungeons and Dragons...
lines.zh: : 她说的是……《龙与地下城》……

lines.en: : Molly wants to play when we go on vacation since she can’t spend much time in the sun without getting burnt...
lines.zh: : Molly 想在我们去度假的时候玩，因为她不能在太阳底下待太久，不然会晒伤……

lines.en: : Correct-a-mundo, Sword-dancer of the Seven Suns.
lines.zh: : 完全正确，七阳之剑舞者。

lines.en: : Is that your nickname, Futaba? That’s the coolest one yet.
lines.zh: : 那是你的外号吗，Futaba？这是目前为止最酷的一个。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe15
: You really...think so, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 您真的……这么觉得吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Hahaha...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : You see, Sir...I’m gathering up able-bodied men and women to compete in a short-term campaign for one night only in whatever building you decide to keep us in!
lines.zh: : 您看，先生……我正在召集身强力壮的男男女女，在您决定关我们的那栋楼里，进行一场只限一夜的短期战役！

lines.en: : Please don’t make it sound like I’m holding you captive.
lines.zh: : 拜托别说得好像我把你们关起来似的。

lines.en: : We are {i}all{/i} but prisoners to the protagonist of the game. And that’s you, Sir. You’re the only male character around.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}不过{/i}是这个游戏主角的囚徒罢了。而那个人就是您，先生。这里唯一的男性角色就是您。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Whatever. But don’t make it sound like that to anyone who isn’t in the class.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行，随便你。但别对班上以外的人说得这么难听。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe16
: Hehehe~ One male and so many females...all housed in close proximity to one another.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿～一个男的配这么多女的……全都挤在同一个屋檐下。

lines.en: : It’s like something straight out of a nukige.
lines.zh: : 简直就像拔作里才会有的情节。

lines.en: : Can I get another weebnote, please?
lines.zh: : 能再来一条宅知识小抄吗？

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe17
: It means a game with a lot of sex.
lines.zh: : 就是那种性爱场面特别多的游戏。

lines.en: : Ahh. That explains why Molly is blushing so much right now.
lines.zh: : 啊。这就难怪 Molly 现在脸红成这样了。

lines.en: : Futaba is too, I’d wager?
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Futaba 也是？

lines.en: : Yup. Both of them are.
lines.zh: : 嗯。她们俩都是。

lines.en: : You are too, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也是。

lines.en: : Nah, this is just how my cheeks look.
lines.zh: : 才不是，我的脸颊本来就是这个颜色。

lines.en: : Three blushing girls would be overkill for one scene, dude. Don’t flatter yourself.
lines.zh: : 一场戏里三个女孩同时脸红，那也太夸张了，老兄。别太抬举自己了。

lines.en: : Worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 总得试一试嘛。

lines.en: : A-Anyway! What I’m trying to ask is if you’d maybe want to get in on some of the action, Sir.
lines.zh: : 总、总之！我想问的是，您有没有兴趣一起加入这场行动，先生。

lines.en: Is she asking what I think she's asking?
lines.zh: 她问的该不会是我想的那个意思吧？

lines.en: : Hell yeah. Of course I’d-
lines.zh: : 那还用说。我当然——

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe18
: She means the campaign, Sensei. She’s not inviting you to an orgy.
lines.zh: : 她说的是战役，Sensei。她不是在邀请您参加群交派对。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well that’s significantly less exciting.
lines.zh: : 那可就无聊多了。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe19
: It’s plenty exciting! Some would even say it’s {i}more{/i} exciting than an orgy!
lines.zh: : 那也很刺激啊！有人甚至会说比群交派对{i}还{/i}刺激！

lines.en: : What sort of sad human being would ever say something like that?...
lines.zh: : 什么样的可怜虫才会说出这种话啊？……

lines.en: : I would!
lines.zh: : 我就会！

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe20
: What would you even do in an orgy with so many people?...There would be like...twelve of us...
lines.zh: : 那么多人一起群交，到底要怎么弄啊？……我们大概有……十二个人吧……

lines.en: : Who would go first? Who would go last?
lines.zh: : 谁先来？谁最后？

lines.en: : Where would we put all of our clothes?
lines.zh: : 我们的衣服要放哪儿？

lines.en: : Would we even {i}bring{/i} clothes?
lines.zh: : 我们真的要{i}穿衣服{/i}去吗？

lines.en: : Can the male body even produce that much-
lines.zh: : 男性的身体真的能产出那么多的——

lines.en: : Okay, Molly. You asked too many questions and Rin is also blushing now.
lines.zh: : 好了，Molly。你问题问得太多了，Rin 现在也脸红了。

lines.en: : Unless that is...also the natural color of her cheeks?
lines.zh: : 除非……她的脸颊本来就是这个颜色？

lines.en: : Nope, definitely blushing.
lines.zh: : 不是，绝对是在脸红。

lines.en: : Anyway, I can’t say I know what’s going to happen on this “educational field trip,” but I’m almost positive there won’t be an orgy that large. Or even at all, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 总之，我不敢说这次「教育见习旅行」上会发生什么，但我几乎可以肯定，不会有那么大规模的群交。甚至根本不会有。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe21
: Ummm...doesn't saying it that way...imply that...it’s possible?
lines.zh: : 嗯……您这种说法……是不是在暗示……是有可能的？

lines.en: Again, I’ve literally watched this world be reset. Nothing is impossible in my head anymore.
lines.zh: 再说一遍，我可是亲眼看着这个世界被重置过。在我脑子里，已经没有什么是不可能的了。

lines.en: : Sure. I mean, who knows when some crazy virus will break out and cause all of the women everywhere to be overcome by lust?
lines.zh: : 说得也是。我是说，谁知道什么时候会爆发某种疯狂的病毒，让全世界的女人都被欲望冲昏头脑呢？

lines.en: : Look, it's already claimed Rin.
lines.zh: : 瞧，Rin 已经被感染了。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe22
: Oh! I’ve played a game like that before!
lines.zh: : 哦！我以前玩过这样的游戏！

lines.en: : {i}All{/i} of the women?...
lines.zh: : {i}全世界{/i}的女人？……

lines.en: : You have strange taste in games, Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly，你在游戏上的品味很奇怪啊。

lines.en: : In fact, you have strange taste in everything.
lines.zh: : 事实上，你在所有事情上的品味都很奇怪。

lines.en: : My tastes are normal! I swear! I’ll even show you my homework folder to confirm this!
lines.zh: : 我的品味很正常！我发誓！我甚至可以把我的作业文件夹给你看，以资证明！

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe23
: Ah, wait! No! I should...probably check it first to make sure that all of the...uhh...more questionable material has been erased!
lines.zh: : 啊，等等！不行！我应该……先检查一下，确认那些……呃……比较有问题的资料都已经删掉了！

lines.en: : If you need to check the folder beforehand, I think that says more than enough about whatever {i}questionable content{/i} you're referencing.
lines.zh: : 如果你需要事先检查那个文件夹，那关于你所指的「{i}有问题的内容{/i}」，我觉得这已经说明够多了。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe24
: I mean...I guess {i}I{/i} could always...you know, give it a look...Since I’m an unaffiliated, unbiased party and everything.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我想{i}我{/i}也可以……你知道的，看一眼……毕竟我是个与双方无涉、毫无偏见的第三方嘛。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe26
: Umm...orgy stuff aside, I do need to know if you’re gonna be joining us, Sir.
lines.zh: : 嗯……先不说群交的事，我确实需要知道您到底要不要加入我们，先生。

lines.en: : I’m kind of neurotic when it comes to organizing stuff, believe it or not. So the sooner I know, the better.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，我在组织活动这方面有点神经质。所以您越早告诉我越好。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, well I don’t think I’ll play. But I wouldn’t mind watching you guys, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，我应该不会下场玩。不过在旁边看你们玩，我倒是不介意。

lines.en: : That would probably be fun in a really...different sort of way.
lines.zh: : 那大概会有一种……很不一样的乐趣。

lines.en: : Are you sure, Sir? It’s a load of fun. Two loads even. So many loads that you won’t even know where to put everything.
lines.zh: : 您确定吗，先生？那可是满「发」的乐趣。两发都不止。多得您都不知道该往哪儿放。

lines.en: : So...many loads...
: You word things very strangely sometimes, Molly...
lines.zh: : Molly，你有时候用词真的很奇怪……

lines.en: : She words things very strangely all the time.
lines.zh: : 她用词一直都很奇怪。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe27
: And yet you still visit me at night!
lines.zh: : 可您还是会在夜里来看我！

lines.en: : Well...are you really sure he's here to see you and that...he didn’t just come for...a pastry or something?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……您真的确定他是来看您的吗？会不会……他只是为了……一块点心什么的来的？……

lines.en: : Molly MacCormack is sweeter than any pastry, Sword-dancer. She is the main course and everyone else is just an appetizer.
lines.zh: : Molly MacCormack 比任何点心都甜美，剑舞者。她是主菜，其他人都只是开胃菜。

lines.en: : It's really impressive how you can be so weird {i}and{/i} conceited at once.
lines.zh: : 你居然能同时这么古怪{i}又{/i}这么自恋，真是令人佩服。

lines.en: scene mollysecondcafe29
: Why wouldn’t I be? Peak Molly-moments always happen when I’m surrounded by my friends!
lines.zh: : 我为什么不呢？最棒的 Molly 时刻，总是发生在我被朋友们围绕的时候！

lines.en: : I’ve gotta hype myself up so I don’t fall behind them and wind up as nothing more than a girl passing by in the end credits.
lines.zh: : 我得给自己造势，免得落在她们后面，最后在片尾字幕里只不过是个路人女孩。

lines.en: : The lead heroine always has to leave a lasting impression, Sir. Which is exactly why I need to remind you all the time about how awesome and powerful I am!
lines.zh: : 第一女主角总得留下令人难忘的印象，先生。所以我就得一直提醒您，我有多厉害、多强大！

lines.en: : And you’ll get to see that power in full-display come time for vacation! Even {i}if{/i} I need to hide my sensitive Irish skin from the sun during daylight!
lines.zh: : 等到了度假的时候，您就能看到这股力量全面展现了！{i}就算{/i}白天我得把我娇嫩的爱尔兰皮肤藏起来躲太阳！

lines.en: : I’m sure I will, Molly...I’m sure I will.
lines.zh: : 我信，Molly……我信。

lines.en: scene black
The four of us hang out at the cafe for another hour or two until it comes time to close up shop.
lines.zh: 我们四个人又在咖啡馆里耗了一两个小时，直到该打烊的时候。

lines.en: I’m honestly surprised that Haruka trusts Molly enough to close this place on her own.
lines.zh: 说实话，我很惊讶 Haruka 竟然放心让 Molly 一个人负责打烊。

lines.en: But I guess just being overly-spontaneous and hyper doesn’t make her a bad employee.
lines.zh: 不过我想，仅仅是因为她过分随性又亢奋，也并不代表她就是个糟糕的员工。

lines.en: After all, when it came time for her to clean things up, she started focusing harder than I've ever seen her focus before.
lines.zh: 毕竟，到了该打扫卫生的时候，她专注起来的样子比我从前见过的任何时候都认真。

lines.en: It was actually a little impressive, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，那还挺让人佩服的。

lines.en: But I guess it doesn't stay impressive for very long as I elect to leave in the middle of her cleaning spree.
lines.zh: 不过这份佩服没持续多久，因为她打扫得起劲时，我选择了开溜。

lines.en: At the end of the day, who wants to watch a girl clean up a restaurant when there’s an equally cute one waiting at home?
lines.zh: 说到底，家里同样有个可爱的女孩在等着，谁还愿意看一个女孩打扫餐厅呢？

lines.en: And so I say goodbye to everyone, turning my back to them as I finally begin to make my way back to the residential district-
lines.zh: 于是我跟大家道别，转过身去，终于踏上回住宅区的路——

lines.en: Thinking about various combinations of orgies the whole way home.
lines.zh: 一路上都在琢磨群交的各种排列组合。
